# Full-Stack Web App Learning Roadmap
## React (Frontend) + Go (Backend)
### 7-Day Intensive Course

---

## 📅 Day 1: Go 基础 / Go Basics

### 上午 / Morning Session

**核心概念 / Core Concepts:**
| English | 中文 |
|---------|------|
| Variables | 变量 |
| Data Types | 数据类型 |
| Control Flow | 控制流 |
| Functions | 函数 |
| Packages | 包 |

**内容 / Content:**
```go
// Go 程序结构 / Go Program Structure
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
    // 变量声明 / Variable Declaration
    name := "World"  // 简短声明 / Short declaration
    var age int = 25 // 标准声明 / Standard declaration
    
    fmt.Printf("Hello, %s!\n", name)
    fmt.Printf("Age: %d\n", age)
}
```

**数据类型 / Data Types:**
```go
// 布尔值 / Boolean
isActive := true

// 数值类型 / Numeric Types
count := 42        // int
price := 3.14      // float64

// 字符串 / String
message := "你好，世界"

// 数组 / Array
numbers := [5]int{1, 2, 3, 4, 5}

// 切片 / Slice (动态数组 / Dynamic array)
names := []string{"Alice", "Bob", "Charlie"}

// 映射 / Map (字典 / Dictionary)
user := map[string]int{"Alice": 30, "Bob": 25}
```

### 下午 / Afternoon Session

**控制流 / Control Flow:**
```go
// 条件语句 / Conditional Statements
score := 85

if score >= 90 {
    fmt.Println("优秀 / Excellent")
} else if score >= 60 {
    fmt.Println("及格 / Passed")
} else {
    fmt.Println("不及格 / Failed")
}

// 循环 / Loops
for i := 0; i < 5; i++ {
    fmt.Printf("Iteration: %d\n", i)
}

// Range 遍历 / Range Iteration
fruits := []string{"Apple", "Banana", "Orange"}
for index, fruit := range fruits {
    fmt.Printf("%d: %s\n", index, fruit)
}

// Switch 语句 / Switch Statement
day := "Monday"
switch day {
case "Saturday", "Sunday":
    fmt.Println("周末 / Weekend")
default:
    fmt.Println("工作日 / Weekday")
}
```
